Point the current priority to S026 FUTURE/UNEXECUTED, label the old override historical, and persist independently observed PR #32 merge parents/tree and actual successful head/main jobs.

Update the packaging manifest and handoff audit for those state fields. All original scientific evidence, source hashes, proof verdicts and the mirrored complete S026 prompt remain unchanged. This is administrative reconciliation only; no new scientific run or S026 invocation.

Validation: exact staged packaging hashes, all 20 pinned tool digests, all 18 complete certificate byte chains, 271 transfer records, prompt mirrors and scaffold checks passed. These are integrity/governance checks, not a new native proof replay.
